profile_text.body:
The Distributed AI Research Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2021 and headquartered in Oakland, California. Its site describes it as a globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research, with the stated belief that technology should benefit everyone. It says it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners who want to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation, and it states that AI is seldom the solution and that its advance should not be treated as inevitable.

The site also notes reflections from Kat, Nyalleng, and Raesetje on Deep Learning Indaba 2026, an annual gathering in Lagos focused on building Africa's AI future. No AI products or MCP servers are recorded for the institute, and no lawsuits are recorded against it.
